messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "use all medications as directed when taking with clarithromycin and/or lansoprazole to treat stomach ulcer"
set: ["use all medications as directed when taking with clarithromycin and/or lansoprazole to treat stomach ulcer", "use all medications as directed", "use exactly as directed", "stomach ulcer", "keep taking the medicine as directed", "use as directed by your doctor", "ongoing, as directed", "lansoprazole", "clarithromycin", "keep using as directed", "use short-acting insulin before meals as directed by doctor when treating type 1 diabetes", "keep using all other medications as prescribed by your doctor", "use exactly as directed on the label or as prescribed by your doctor", "tell doctor about all medications", "keep using the medication as directed", "use as soon as possible"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
